knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r readin}
cases_year <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-06-24/cases_year.csv') 
health <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-09-29/health.csv') 
```


```{r join}
#merge and clean up 1, redone into cleanup 2
#cleanup 2
cases_year <- cases_year %>%
  select(-total_suspected_measles_rubella_cases, -rubella_total, -rubella_lab_confirmed, -rubella_epi_linked,
         -rubella_clinical, -rubella_incidence_rate_per_1000000_total_population, -discarded_cases, 
         -discarded_non_measles_rubella_cases_per_100000_total_population, -annualized_population_most_recent_year_only)

cases_2025 <- cases_year %>%
  filter(year == "2025")

health_name <- health %>%
  rename(country = GC_CNT_GAD_2025) %>%
  filter(country %in% cases_2025$country)

merged_cases_2025 <- full_join(cases_2025, health_name, by = "country")

#check join success (looking at accents on words, etc)
non_merged_cases_2025 <- anti_join(cases_2025, health_name, by = "country")
#not all countries have the same name in both datasets, need to fuzzyjoin to fix this
```
